Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh will be high on confidence at the moment and will look to carry the same into their batting. The target is very much achievable but they will need their batsmen to sensibly pace the chase. New Zealand have an excellent bowling attack and it's not going to be easy for them. Do join us in a short while for all the action from second innings.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, New Zealand got off to a decent start. Almost all their batsmen got starts but none went on to score big. It eventually cost them towards the end, as a set batsman at the death would have helped their cause. Let's give credit to Bangladesh for the way they bowled. They never allowed the Kiwis to run away with the game, even when the wickets were not falling. Their persistence paid off and they will be immensely pleased with the overall effort in the field.

Outstanding death bowling by Bangladesh! The introduction of Mosaddek Hossain at the back end of the innings did wonders as he claimed three wickets and didn't allow the Kiwis to step on the gas. The downfall for New Zealand however began when Taskin Ahmed removed Ross Taylor in the 39th over. They slipped from a great position and managed only 64 runs in the last 11.2 overs.

FOUR! Hossain will be disappointed with the ball. High full toss on the leg stump. Southee helps it to the fine leg boundary. Not called a no ball for height. A good way for the Kiwis to end the innings. NEW ZEALAND FINISH ON 265/8.
Bowls it full on the pads, Santner hits it through mid-wicket for a run.
Yorker on the stumps, Santner does well to dig it out straight back to the bowler. Brilliant bowling.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads and rolls towards the right of the keeper as Rahim makes a fine stop.
Bowls it full on the stumps, Santner is early into the slog and gets a leading edge down to third man. There is a fumble there which allows them to come back for the second.
Tries to be innovative. Goes for the ramp over short fine leg but does not connect as Rubel bowls it very full. The ball takes an inside edge to fine leg for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! MUCH-NEEDED! Southee walks across the stumps, Mustafizur bowls a slower one. Southee flicks it through square leg for a boundary.

Not out! Full length ball on off, Southee backs away and hits it to covers. Santner sets of for a run but is sent back. The fielder at covers scores a direct hit at his end. They go upstairs to check. Santner's dive saves him as he just makes his ground.
Run out appeal is taken upstairs...
Tim Southee is the new batsman. He can hit long and New Zealand certainly need that from him.

OUT! MUSTAFIZUR, YOU BEAUTY! A slower ball followed up by a fast and a very full delivery on middle. Milne walks across and goes to flick it but misses it and the ball knocks over his stumps going through his legs. First wicket for Mustafizur in the Champions Trophy.
Bowls a cutter on off, it spins away, Milne tries to cut but gets beaten. This is superb death bowling.
Full and wide outside off, Milne slashes at it and gets it over point for a couple.
Mustafizur is back into the attack.
Full ball on the pads, Santner flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
The yorker outside off, Santner goes to hit it over the off side but misses.

BIG APPEAL! Hossain bowls it full on the stumps, Santner shuffles across and goes for the flick but misses and is struck on the pads. They make a loud appeal but the umpire gives it not out as there was an inside edge. Santner was eyeing a run but was sent back. A direct hit at his end would have sent him back.
Bowls a yorker just outside off, Santner tries to go over the off side but does not connect.
Bowls a high full toss outside off, Santner tries to go over cover but misses. He will be disappointed he missed out.
Bowls a yorker, Milne does well to dig it out through square leg for a single
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
Length ball on off, Milne drives it uppishly to mid off for a run.
Bowls length on the pads, Milne flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
Full ball on off, Santner drives it through mid off for a run.
Slower ball outside off, Milne guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball on middle, Milne flicks it to short mid-wicket.
WIDE! Bowls a bouncer, the ball bounces way over the batsman's head. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on off, Santner pushes it off the back foot through cover-point for a single.

OUT! Neesham is stumped! Smart bowling by Mosaddek. He senses the charge from the southpaw and pulls his length back. Fires it outside off and Jimmy is through with his shot early and misses the ball completely. Rahim quietly takes the bails off and straightaway jumps in joy. Brilliant bowling. Bangladesh are doing a great work at the back end of the innings.
Flatter on off, Neesham gets back and keeps it out on the off side. For some reason, Rahim was appealing. Maybe he thought it was pad first as the batsman played too close to his body.
Too full in length and it's well flighted, Santner bunts it down to long on for one.
A low full toss has been flicked off the pads to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Works it off his pads to mid-wicket but finds the fielder.

Advances down the track and forces it straight back past the bowler. Sabbir Rahman does well to cut it off with a full length dive near the fence after running across to his right from long on. Saves a run for his side.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Shortish on off, Santner tries to pull but misses.
Driven through the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it through covers for a run.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Slower in pace, Neesham mistimes his cut through covers for one.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Tosses it up, Neesham drives it to mid off for a run. Outstanding over, 3 runs and a couple of wicket from it!
Flattish and sliding in. Neesham punches it to covers.
Quicker ball, Santner pushes it down the ground for a run.
Mitchell Santner is the new batsman.

OUT! Anderson bags a golden duck! Mosaddek is the man of the moment. Bowls it flatter on the stumps, Anderson goes back and tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits him low on the pads. They all appeal and the umpire gives him out. Anderson walks off but Neesham calls him back and asks him to review. It looks plumb to the naked eye. They go upstairs. The replays show the ball pitches in line, struck him in line of the stumps and is crashing into the leg stump. Three reds and the dangerous Corey Anderson has to depart. Mosaddek gets his second wicket in the over.
Anderson is given LBW and he reviews it. It looks very close to the naked eye.
Fires it on the pads, Neesham flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Corey Anderson comes out to the middle.

OUT! MOSADDEK STRIKES! This is why he was brought into the attack. Broom tries to go big. He comes down the track, Mosaddek pulls back his length. Broom goes ahead with the shot but gets a top edge. The ball goes straight up in the air and Tamim Iqbal at short third man comes running in and takes a good catch. The move to bowl Mosaddek has paid off.
Bowls it on a length, Broom comes down the track and pushes it through covers for a run.
Good length on middle, Neesham flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Full on off, Neesham drives it past mid off for another boundary. Two boundaries from the over.
FOUR! Short ball on the body, Neesham rocks back and pulls it powerfully to the right of square leg for a boundary.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Broom flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Nearly rolls onto the stumps! Bangs in a short delivery, well-directed, Neesham is hurried up by the pace, tries to fend it away but misses. Takes a blow on his body and it could have easily gone onto the stumps on another day. His partner calls him through for a quick single. Maybe some glove there.
Flatter ball on middle, Neesham gets back to punch it through mid on. The bowler runs himself after it and stops it with a slide near the circle. Only a run taken.
On the pads, quicker through the line, flicked through square leg for a single.
Skidding down the leg side, worked behind square leg for a run.
Advances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Goes back to a shortish ball and punches it through extra cover for a single.
Beaten first up! Quicker delivery, fired around off, Neesham gets back to defend but misses.
Mosaddek Hossain is brought into the attack. Very late in the innings but this move can prove to be handy.
Full ball on the pads, Neesham flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
EDGY FOUR! Length ball angling across, Neesham pokes at it and gets an outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Broom drives it to mid off for a run.
Bowls a length on the stumps, Broom tries to flick it but the ball hurries at him, takes the top edge over short mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angles in a delivery, Broom looks to pull but it stays a tad low and beats his bat.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. A maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Short outside off, Neesham cuts it to point.
WIDE! Goes for the yorker but drifts down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Aims it at the rib cage of the batsman, Neesham tucks it down on the leg side.
Bowls it short on off, Neesham ducks under it.
Length ball on middle, Broom tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it full on the stumps, Broom defends it off the front foot.
Full ball outside off, Broom drives it straight to point.
Neesham defends it from within the crease.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Jimmy Neesham strides out to the middle.

OUT! Massive breakthrough for Bangladesh, Taylor falls. Clever change in pace by Taskin Ahmed has brought Ross' downfall. He takes the pace off the delivery and serves it on a back of a length in the line of the stumps at 111 kph. Taylor shuffles across the stumps to play the paddle scoop but it comes from the higher part of the bat. It balloons in the air, Mustafizur Rahman runs forward from short fine leg and completes the catch with a stretch. Well done, Bangladesh.
Shout for a catch! Taskin Ahmed digs in a short ball around off, Ross Taylor tries to hook by taking his eyes off the ball but fails to connect. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Turns it in the gap on the leg side for a couple of runs. 200 up for New Zealand.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Bowls a cutter on the stumps, Taylor goes for a heave but gets it from the inner half of the bat wide of mid on for a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball, Taylor tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length, Taylor plays it to point.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Taylor goes for the flick but misses it and the umpire signals a wide.
Cutter on off, Broom pushes it through the off side for a run.
Full ball on off, Broom drives it straight back to the bowler.
Bowls it on middle, Broom flicks to fine leg for a run. 11 runs of the over.
Full on the stumps, Taylor drives it to mid-wicket for a run.
Long on has been pushed back and fine leg comes in.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Full ball and Taylor lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Two boundaries in this over now.
What happened there? Taskin bowls a short one on off, Taylor first goes to pull but then bails out of the shot. The ball skids through and hits his bat and rolls to the cover region.
Bowled on the pads, Broom flicks it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Broom cuts it behind point for a boundary. Good start to the over for New Zealand.
Slower ball on off, Taylor pushes it to extra cover. Three off the over. Good over here for Bangladesh.
Length ball outside off, Taylor goes for a cut but gets an inside edge and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Bowls a low full toss wide of off, Taylor drives it through cover-point for a couple.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
YORKER! Broom does well to dig it out to mid-wicket for a run.
A tad fuller on off, Broom defends it off the front foot.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
Strays on the pads, Broom flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Short ball on the stumps, Taylor pulls it down to deep square leg for a run.
Bowls it on a length, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
Full ball on off, Broom drives it to the left of mid off for a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Broom tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
37th ODI fifty for Ross Taylor.
Length ball outside off, Taylor cuts it down to third man for a run. He brings up his fifty. He knows the job is only half done and he has to stay till the end.
Taskin Ahmed is back to bowl.
Tosses it up, Taylor drives it to long off for a run. End of Shakib's spell today, goes wicketless.
Floats it on off, Broom dives it through covers for a run.
Fires it on the stumps, Broom flicks it to the leg side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tosses it up, Broom drives it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Bowls it outside off, Broom dabs it past short third man for a boundary. Boundary off the first ball there.
Drinks break.
Full slower ball on the stumps, Broom drives it to long on for a run.
Length ball, Broom defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on the stumps, Broom plays it to mid-wicket.
JUST SHORT! Bowls a cutter on off, Broom tries to tuck it on the leg side. The ball sticks on the wicket and Broom gets a leading edge just short of the fielder at covers.
Length ball on off, Taylor guides it down to third man for a run.
BIG APPEAL! Length ball around off, Taylor shuffles across and goes for the flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Looked close.
Short outside off, Broom cuts it through point for a couple.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full ball, Taylor drives it to covers where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Fires it in, Broom flicks it to the right of mid on for a run.
Floats it on off, Taylor drives it down to long off for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Broom flicks it through square leg for a run.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Broom attempts a flick but misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Probably a cutter, full and around off, Taylor plays it late and closes the face of the bat to push it towards mid-wicket.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! This shot will give him immense confidence. He is under the pump for his place in the middle order and would like to make this innings count. Coming to the delivery, it's full and around off, Broom executes an eye-catching straight drive for a boundary. This shot will make Sachin Tendulkar proud.
Fullish and on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Uppish but safe! This one stops a bit on the batsman, Neil is squared up in defense and the ball catches the leading edge. Luckily for him, the ball falls safely at covers.
Slower delivery on off, Broom defends it from the crease to the off side.
Neil Broom comes out to bat. He has an amazing record against Bangladesh, hitting 3 fifties and a hundred. New Zealand will need him to fire today in this must-win game.

OUT! Williamson, what have you done there? There was never a run. Shakib bowls it slower through the air on the pads, Taylor flicks it to short fine leg. Williamson sets off for a run but is sent back by Taylor. Mosaddek at short fine leg throws a wide throw at the non-striker's end where Shakib collects it brilliantly and disturbs the stumps. Williamson was way short of the crease. The pressure they were building pays off. End of the 83-run stand. They get the big wicket of Williamson. Can they build on it now?
Taylor attempts a sweep but is hit on the pads.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Short ball on the leg stump. Taylor pulls it behind square leg for a boundary. That must have released all the pressure Bangladesh were building.
Floats it on off, Taylor drives it to mid off for no run.
Tosses it up, Taylor drives it to mid on.

Appeal for an LBW! Full ball on leg stump, Taylor goes for the sweep but gets hit on the pads. They all appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Taylor tries to run a single but is sent back. The fielder at short fine leg tries to score a direct hit but misses. Had he hit, Ross was a goner. Quite an eventful first ball.
Mishit! An off pace delivery in the line of the stumps, Williamson moves back and steps down to go over covers but inside edges it towards mid-wicket. Lovely over by the Bangla skipper.
Full and angling into the batsman, it's played off the pads but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Gets forward and pushes it to mid on for a sharp single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but no harm done.
On a length and around off, Taylor taps it down with an angled bat to point. The fielder dives to his right to make an excellent stop.
Slower length ball on off, Taylor plays it late and pushes it towards point. His partner wants the single but is sent back.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Tosses it up on off, Taylor drives it through covers for a run.
Taylor comes down the track, tries to drive but it takes the inside edge and nearly carries to mid-wicket.
Darts it on the stumps, Taylor rocks on to the back foot and punches it.

Comes down the track, Shakib sees him and fires it down the leg side. Taylor gets his pads in the way and stops it from going through to the keeper. Smart work there, if it had not hit his pads, Mushfiqur would have had an easy stumping.
Tosses it up, Williamson sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Comes down the track and drives it past the bowler who dives, but is not able to stop it. The ball goes to long off and they run through for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, Williamson attempts the flick but gets hit high on the pads.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball outside off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a run.
Full on the pads, Williamson flicks it on the leg side for a couple.
Bowled it around off, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball on the stumps, Williamson punches it to mid on for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. One run added to the total.
Tosses it up on off, Williamson drives it to cover.
Comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Fires it on the stumps, Williamson punches it off the back foot for a run.
Tosses it on the stumps, Taylor drives it to covers for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers.

MIX UP! Length ball outside off, Williamson pushes it to covers. They run a single. Attempt for a second but there is a collision between Taylor and Rubel. Williamson turns and tries to get back, Mahmudullah throws it at the striker's end but Williamson makes his ground. Plenty of action.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Short on the stumps, Taylor rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
31st ODI fifty for Kane Williamson!

Fab knock! Length ball outside off, gets a little more bounce. Williamson does well to control his shot and runs it down to third man for a run. The run brings up his fifty. It has been a very good knock by the man in form and this is his third 50-plus score in a row in this tournament. Amazing.
Length ball on off, Williamson plays it to the point region.
A tad full on the pads, Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls on the pads, Williamson works it through square leg for a run.
Rubel Hossain comes back into the attack.
Bowls it on the pads, Taylor plays it to mid-wicket.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Fires it on the stumps, Williamson punches it off the back foot.
Floats it on the stumps, Williamson heaves it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Flights it on the stump, Taylor flicks it on the leg side.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball outside off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Williamson flicks it through square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length, Williamson plays it to point.
50-run stand up between Ross Taylor and Kane Williamson.
FOUR! Rahman bowls it too full on the stumps, Williamson leans into the drive and times it brilliantly down the ground for a boundary.
Length ball angling across the batsman, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it on the stumps, Williamson comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Comes down the track and drives the ball to long off for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
Full ball outside off, Williamson drives it through covers for a run.
Darts it on leg stump, Williamson pushes it to mid on.
Bowls it slower through the air on the pads, Taylor flicks it to square leg for a run.
Lands the cutter on a length outside off, Taylor plays it with soft hands on the off side and they run a single.
Length ball on off, Taylor pushes it to mid off.
Bowls a length ball on the stumps, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball angling across, Williamson defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Taylor flicks it through square leg for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Taylor flicks it to fine leg for a run. Mustafizur Rahman misfields but they don't take the second run.
Flights it on the stumps, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
Darts in onto the pads, Williamson pushes it to long on for a run.
Taylor comes down the track and drives the ball through covers for a run.
Tosses it on the stumps, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
Flights it on off stump, Williamson cuts it to point for a run.
Fuller and on middle, pushed down to mid on to end the over.
Another watchful leave outside off by Taylor.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Straighter in line this time, Kane nudges it fine down the leg side for one.
FOUR! Sublime. Williamson is a treat to watch. Gets a fuller length ball outside off and drives it elegantly through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Wide! Too full and way wide outside off, Williamson leaves it.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Bowled on the pads, Williamson flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. They pick up a single.
Huge shout again! Tosses it up on the stumps, Taylor comes down the track and tries to flick it but misses it and gets struck on the pads. They all go up but the umpire shakes his head.
Darts it on the stumps, Williamson punches it to long on for a run.
Tosses it on the stumps, Ross chips it to long on for a run.

FOUR! WAS THAT BAT OR PAD? Tosses it on off, Taylor paddle sweeps it. Shakib makes a loud appeal but the umpire is not interested and the ball races away to the fine leg fence. The umpire signals a boundary. Replays confirm there was only bat there.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Lands it on a length outside off, Taylor lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson cuts it through cover-point for a run.
Lands it on a length on middle, Taylor tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Length ball on off, Williamson guides it down to third man. Runs the first run hard and wants to come back for the second but is rightly sent back by Taylor.
Full ball on off, Williamson drives it to mid off.
Fired it on middle, Williamson pushes it to long off for a run.
Tosses it on middle, Williamson flicks it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Darts it onto the pads, Taylor flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Drifts it on the pads, Taylor flicks it to short fine leg.
Bowls it on the stumps, Williamson pushes it down to long on for a run.
Shakib sees the batsman coming down the wicket and drags his length back a little, Taylor looks to adjusts but gets an inside edge to the square leg side for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan is brought on to bowl.
Drinks are on the field now. New Zealand got of to a blistering start, but two wickets in the middle have pulled the run rate back a bit.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff from the bowler. Length ball outside off, straightens off the deck. Williamson pokes at it and gets beaten.
Length ball on the stumps, Williamson goes for the flick but misses it and is struck on the pads.
Square leg drops back.
Back of a length ball, Williamson defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Williamson pushes it off the back foot to cover.
A tad short outside off, Taylor cuts it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length ball, Williamson punches it off the back foot to cover-point for a run.

FOUR! A couple of fantastic shots from the bat of Ross Taylor. This time the length is full as it angles into the batsman, Taylor once again gets forward with a vertical bat and forces it past the non-striker's end for a boundary down the ground.
FOUR! Fine shot! Taskin Ahmed misses the yorker mark this time and delivers a low full toss on off, Taylor presents a straight bat and caresses it past the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Spears it in this time, full and angling into the batsman, Taylor falls over the off side in his stance as he flicks across the line. Finds mid on.
Tries tempting the batsman with a delivery in the channel outside off, Taylor decides not to flirt with it.
Good length ball shaping back into the batsman from outside off, excellent pace, 145 kph, Taylor defends it from the crease.
Almost a yorker, reaches the batsman on a low full toss, Williamson digs it out to mid on for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended to end a successful over.
Wide called! Good intent though from the bowler. Digs in a short delivery to greet the new batsman, around middle and leg with a leg gully in place. Taylor ducks underneath it.
Ross Taylor comes out to the middle. There are two slips in place for Ross Taylor.

OUT! Guptill has been adjudged lbw! Brilliant delivery by Rubel Hossain. Gets a length ball to nip back into the batsman from around off, Guptill fails to keep it out and is hit high on the front pad. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The bowler jumps in joy and Guptill after having a brief chat with his skipper walks back to the pavilion. He was thinking about reviewing it but probably Williamson advised him against it. The replays show that it's clipping the top of middle stump. Fair call to not waste the only review. Another start not converted by Martin!
Shortish again, on off, Williamson punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
FOUR! Aahh...you cannot bowl there to any batsman, forget this batsman. Nearly a leg stump half-volley, Williamson cashes in by flicking it wide of mid on for a gorgeous boundary.

Sharp delivery by Rubel, hits the deck hard and serves it on a shortish length outside off, Williamson once again tries to run it down to third man but it comes from the splice of the bat. The widish first slip fielder makes the stop.
On a good length just outside off, Williamson leans back and runs it fine down to third man. Good running between the wickets to take the second run.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.

BIG APPEAL! Beats him on the inside this time. Length ball outside off, jags in a little, Williamson tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire is not interested. Bangladesh opt not to review. Looked a little high.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Williamson pokes at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length ball on off, the batsman guides it to point.
Lands it on a length outside off, Williamson lets it go through to the keeper.
Full length ball outside off, Williamson lets it go through to the keeper. The ball comes in a little after it goes past the batsman and Mushfiqur dives to his left and collects the ball.
Back of a length ball, Guptill defends it off the back foot.
Full ball on stumps, Guptill drives it back straight down the ground. No timing there.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
EDGED! Length ball on off, Williamson tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Williamson lets the ball through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on off, Williamson pushes it off the back foot.
Rubel Hossain comes on to bowl. Powerplay 2 is underway. Bangladesh can have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off for a run.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Williamson pokes at it and gets beaten.
FOUR! WHAT TIMING! Full ball on off, Williamson times it beautifully to the left of mid off and the ball races to the boundary.
Back of a length on off, Williamson defends it off the back foot.
Short ball on the ribs of the batsman, Guptill tickles it down on the leg side for a run.
Fuller length on off, Guptill pushes it to mid off.
Length ball outside off, Williamson tries to push it off the back foot but gets beaten. There is some oohhzz and aahhzz  from the crowd.
Full ball, Guptill drives it down the ground for a single. The mid off fielder runs to his right and stops the ball.
Back of a length ball on off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! He is just so good. Slightly short outside off, Williamson square cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. 50 up for New Zealand.
Back of a length ball on middle, Williamson defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it on a length on off, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a run.
Lands it on a fuller length on the stumps, Williamson defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Guptill guides it down to point for a run.
Kane Williamson strides out to the middle. A widish slip and a leg gully in for him.

OUT! TASKIN STRIKES! First one down for New Zealand. Taskin bowls it on a length around off, gets a little shape into the batsman, Ronchi tries to heave it over the leg side but gets it off the splice of the bat and goes straight up in the air. Mustafizur Rahman at mid on pedals back a little and takes an easy catch. Taskin is all pumped up. Bangladesh needed this breakthrough.
Full on the stumps, Ronchi drives it straight. Mortaza gets a hand to it but cannot stop the single as the ball deflects to mid off.
Good length on off, Ronchi punches it off the back foot.
Bowls it on a fuller length on the stumps, Ronchi comes down the track and mishits it inside out over covers for a couple. The ball bounces and stops due to the wet outfield.
Lands it on a length on off, Guptill punches it off the back foot to mid off for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Shortish length ball outside off, Guptill rocks back and slaps it through covers for a boundary. He looks in good form here.
Bowls it short on off, Ronchi does well to evade it.
Lands it on a length on off, Ronchi guides it down to third man for a couple.
FOUR! Crisply driven. Full ball outside off, Ronchi leans into the drive and hits it through covers for a boundary. A good start for New Zealand.
Length ball outside off, Ronchi charges down and tries to lift it over covers but gets beaten.
Full ball on off, Guptill drives it through extra cover for a run.
Back of a length ball outside off, Guptill goes for the punch but gets beaten. Good carry there for Taskin.
Taskin Ahmed comes into the attack.
A tad fuller, Ronchi drives it straight down the ground for no run.
Back of a length ball, Guptill punches it off the back foot to long on for a run.
Slower ball on off, Guptill defends it on the off side.
Full length ball on off, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Length ball on off, Guptill punches it through covers for a boundary. 10 off the first 2 balls.

SIX! BANG! Top shot. Mortaza lands it on a length on off, Guptill comes down the track and hits it over the mid off fielder for a maximum. Trademark Guptill shot. Meanwhile, the ball is lost and the umpires call for a new one.
It's drizzling again. Seems like a passing shower as the umpires decide to stay.
FOUR! Good length ball outside off, Ronchi gives himself room and smashes it over point for a boundary. Good over for New Zealand.
Length ball on middle, Ronchi clips it over the leg side for a couple.
Full length ball on off, Ronchi drives it to covers.
BEATEN! Good line from Rahman. Length ball on off, angling away. Ronchi pokes at it and gets beaten.
Full ball on off, Guptill drives it to the left of mid off for a run.

Tight run! Full ball on off, Ronchi drives it to the right of cover-point and sets off for a run. Sabbir stationed there tries to hit the stumps at the non striker's end but misses. That would have been touch and go in case of a direct hit.
Lands it on a shortish length on off, Guptill defends off the back foot. Maiden over from Mortaza.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, staying low, Guptill pushes it off the back foot however not from the middle of the bat.
Lands it on a length, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
Good bowling! Length ball outside off which comes in a touch. Guptill leaves the ball through to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Guptill tries to cut it hard but gets an under edge and the ball rolls to the off side.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Guptill lets the ball through to the keeper.
Bowls it on the stumps, Ronchi defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Ronchi taps it down to covers.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full on the pads of Guptill, he flicks it through mid-wicket for three.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Full on off, Guptill pushes it through cover-point and the ball races away to the fence. It will race away even though the outfield is wet due to the rain.
FOUR! Not in control though. Full ball outside off, Guptill drives it aerially through cover-point for a boundary. First boundary for New Zealand. Guptill will like to get his shot execution better.
Mustafizur Rahman will bowl with the second new ball.
Length ball outside off, Ronchi lets it go through to the keeper.

ALMOST! Bangladesh almost get their first. Length ball outside off, Guptill pokes at it and gets an outside edge and it goes through the vacant second slip area. It's the first over and there should have been a second slip. The batsmen run through for a single.
Bowls it on a length, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length, Guptill defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball outside off, Guptill defends it off the back foot.
Length ball down the leg side, Guptill tries to flick it but misses. Bangladesh appeal but the umpire is not interested. Strange it was not called a wide. Replays suggest it did not touch anything.

A little bit of rain in the air again. But it's not stopping the players from taking the field. Good breeze blowing across the stadium which will help to take the clouds away. Luke Ronchi and Martin Guptill are the New Zealand openers. Mashrafe Mortaza to kickoff proceedings with the first new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...

Time for the national anthems. The players from both sides are out in the middle. We are minutes away from the start. The conditions at the moment is still overcast and the Bangladesh pacers will be hoping for some assistance. Hard work for the Kiwi batsmen up front.

Bangladesh skipper Mashrafe Mortaza says that he would have bowled anyway. Informs that Taskin Ahmed and Mosaddek Hossain come in for Imrul Kayes and Mehedi Hasan. Adds that they need to improve their fast bowling attack and since the pitch was under the cover, he is expecting some early movement. Also wants other batsmen to step up and support Tamim Iqbal who has been in stupendous form. Feels that they did beat New Zealand recently but today is a different ball game and they will have to play good cricket.

New Zealand skipper Kane Williamson says, they will opt to bat. Feels that it's a pretty good surface and quite dry underneath. Hopes to post a good score on the board. Says they are playing an unchanged team and on the question of any consideration for changing the middle order, he replies that all his batsmen are exciting players and he is backing them all the way. Admits it's a tough game today and they will have to play well.
TOSS - New Zealand win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - The pitch is not as hard as it has been in the tournament. It looks an abrasive surface and might be two-paced. It seems to be a bat first wicket. 250 is a par score here, says Ian Bishop.

New Zealand, on the other hand, have been overdependent on their skipper Kane Williamson. The Black Caps will want their middle order to fire in this all-important game. The Kiwis are favourites but it all depends on who performs better on the day. They were beaten by the Asian side in their last encounter in Dublin and will be aware of the threat that the Asian team possesses. Can Bangladesh again spring a surprise today? Stay with us to find out.

This is the last game of the group stage for both the sides and a knockout as well. The Bangla Tigers were lucky to steal a point against Australia as the match got abandoned. They were poor in the last game against the Aussies. Tamim Iqbal has been the only one to show great form with the bat and the side from the subcontinent would hope he delivers again in this crunch contest. Mashrafe Mortaza will want the rest of his boys to step up too.

Hello and welcome to Match No. 9 of the ICC Champions Trophy between New Zealand and Bangladesh in Cardiff. After a delay of an hour due to the wet outfield we are all set to get underway. The groundsmen have done a very good job in getting the ground ready for the game.
